items.q: It is high time the government ___ steps against corruption. (take)
items.rule_bn: 'It is high time'-এর পরে past form: took।

items.q: He behaves as though he ___ everything. (own)

items.rule_bn: Past unreal: Had + V3, ... would/could have + V3।

items.q: The teacher, with his students, ___ visiting the fair. (be)
items.rule_bn: 'with' মূল subject (The teacher) পরিবর্তন করে না: is/was।

items.q: Lest he ___ fail, he studied hard. (should)
I would rather starve than ___ (beg). (base form)
items.rule_bn: 'would rather ... than'-এর পরে base verb: beg।

items.q: He is looking forward to ___ (meet) you. (verb+ing)
Not only the boys but also the teacher ___ present. (be, past)
items.rule_bn: 'not only...but also'-এ কাছের subject (the teacher=singular): was।
